subject: Trial gating & exec sign-off plan for ACME Health
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Simon Patel <simon@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + proposed trial gates and timeline

Simon — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and our recommended next steps so we’re all aligned before we lock the pilot workbook.

High-level ask from ACME: validate 1) extraction accuracy on claims notes (NLP F1 >= 0.88), 2) inference latency under 350ms p99 at 200 concurrent users, and 3) no PHI leaves your VPC during the trial.

Proposed trial structure (pilot length: 4 weeks):
- Week 0: onboarding & infra connect (redwood private agent deployed into your staging VPC)
- Week 1–3: focused evaluation on accuracy, latency, and edge-cases (we provide evaluation harness + sample prompts)
- Week 4: consolidation, final metrics, exec readout and go/no-go decision

Owners we propose:
- Redwood: Marissa (trial design, runbooks), Dylan (technical contact, infra), Tessa (contracting escalation)
- ACME: Simon (product), Priya (security/compliance)

Immediate asks:
1) Can you confirm the success criteria above (esp. the 0.88 F1 floor)?
2) Please confirm target exec readout window the week of Aug 2–6 (we recommend Aug 5, 2027 11am PT as a tentative slot)
3) Confirm ACME legal point of contact for a quick SOW addendum (if trial expands to paid PO on acceptance)

I’ve attached a first-pass evaluation_plan_v2.pdf and a lightweight trial_matrix.csv that maps tests to owners. If that looks good I’ll schedule the onboarding call and lock the exec slot tentatively.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

--
Dylan Brooks
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
D: +1 415 555 0119
From: Simon Patel <simon@acmehealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed trial gates and timeline

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the clear plan. Quick replies inline: 

- Success criteria: the 0.88 F1 floor is acceptable as long as you can show clear examples and a small error analysis for the false positives we discussed.
- Latency: p99 < 350ms at ~200 concurrent users is our target. We need to see a short load test in staging during Week 2.
- PHI: Priya will confirm our security checklist but high priority is that inference happens inside our VPC and logs are scrubbed.

Exec readout: Aug 5 at 11am PT works for our leadership (I checked with the PM and head of ops).

Legal: looping in Priya for confirmation of the SOW contact — she’s handling procurement for pilots.

Two items from our side:
1) We have a small subset of redacted real records (10k rows) we can share for the evaluation harness — I’ll get a secure transfer link to you by EOD tomorrow.
2) Can Redwood provide a brief runbook for failure modes (what happens if latency breaches SLO)? That helps our SREs sign off.

Simon
Head of Product, ACME Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-demo recap + proposed trial gates and timeline

Looping in a few internal ops details and owners.

Dylan — I updated the evaluation_plan_v2.pdf with a short error analysis template and added a failure-mode appendix (see attachment stub). I also expanded the trial_matrix.csv to include the load-test scripts and data transfer checklist.

Owner confirmations:
- Onboarding call (Week 0): Dylan (lead), Marissa (runbook walkthrough), SRE (TBD from infra team)
- Load testing (Week 2): Marissa + infra SRE (I’ll request a temporary test pool)
- Security sign-off (week 3): Tessa to coordinate with Priya (ACME) and our security lead; we’ll prepare the scrub report template
- Exec readout (Week 4): Dylan (customer facing), Marissa (results deck), VP Sales (if exec asks for commercial context)

Contracting note: if ACME wants the paid PO path after go/no-go we’ll need a short SOW addendum + a one-page pricing sheet. Tessa, can you prepare a draft addendum and a rough pricing one-pager we can send to Priya?

Attachments referenced (stubs): evaluation_plan_v2.pdf (updated), trial_matrix.csv (expanded), failure_mode_appendix.docx

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Simon Patel <simon@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <priya@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Jul 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed trial gates and timeline

Simon/Priya — great, thank you both for the quick alignment. Finalizing next steps below so we can convert this into a calendar + HubSpot plan.

1) Data transfer: Simon to provide secure transfer link by Tue 2027-07-27 EOD (you noted tomorrow in the thread — we got a stub but will wait for the full link).
2) Onboarding call (Week 0): we’ll run a 60-minute joint kick-off on Mon Aug 2 at 9am PT. Calendar invite to follow.
3) Load test (Week 2): target Wed Aug 11 for the staged load run; Marissa to own runbook.
4) Exec readout: confirmed Aug 5, 2027 11am PT — preliminary deck will be shared by Aug 4 COB. Please confirm attendees so we can include the right execs.
4) Contracts: Tessa will send a short SOW addendum + pricing sheet to Priya by Aug 3. If ACME signs the addendum within 5 business days after go/no-go we can transition to a paid pilot and reserve dedicated capacity.

Attachments included (stubs): evaluation_plan_v2.pdf, trial_matrix.csv
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ACME-2027-TRIAL-78, https://docusign.com/preview/ACME-TRIAL-78

Let me know if any of the timelines above are a hard no and we’ll adjust. Otherwise I’ll send the onboarding invite and lock the exec slot on our calendar.

Thanks all —
Dylan
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
